info.title: CamusDB Web Console
info.description: CamusDB.WebConsole allows database management from a Web UI.

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: CamusDB server to connect to (default: http://localhost:5095)

options.name: --user
options.description: User to sign in as; give the password in the Configure dialog

options.name: --port
options.description: Local port of the console; 0 picks a free port (default: 5164)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
The console listens on 127.0.0.1 only. To serve other machines, set the address yourself with
--urls or ASPNETCORE_URLS, and read the hosting notes in the README first:
https://github.com/camusdb/camusdb-webconsole
Every setting of appsettings.json can also come from the environment, for example
CamusDB__Endpoint or CamusDB__Password.
